headline: Fever 96-77 Lynx: Clark 27 and 9 as Indiana stuns top seed
whyCareReason: Caitlin Clark delivered 27 points and 9 assists as Indiana routed the top-seeded Minnesota Lynx 96-77 on 22 September. A statement victory ahead of the playoffs.
teaser: FINAL: Fever 96, Lynx 77. Clark 27 points, 9 assists, 7 rebounds. Mitchell 20 points. Lynx locked into No. 1 seed. Playoffs begin 27 September.
story:
Why this one matters: with the regular season in its closing days, the Indiana Fever delivered their most complete performance of the campaign, dominating the league-leading Minnesota Lynx 96-77 on Tuesday night.

WNBA.com and the Associated Press report that Caitlin Clark commanded the floor from the opening tip, finishing with 27 points, nine assists, and seven rebounds. Kelsey Mitchell provided the perimeter firepower with 20 points, allowing Indiana to pull away in the second half.

Minnesota had already secured the No. 1 overall seed for the postseason, but the Fever's emphatic win cements Indiana as one of the most dangerous opponents entering the eight-team playoff bracket on Sunday 27 September.
stakes: Indiana solidifies momentum and playoff seeding while testing the league's top team on their home floor.
rivalryAngle: A burgeoning rivalry between Minnesota's defensive depth and Indiana's high-octane perimeter backcourt.
